title: ref(security): Bump the rrweb family to the @sentry scope 2.44.0
body:
Moves the whole rrweb family off the old `@sentry-internal` scope onto the current Svelte-5 **2.44.0** builds (republished under the `@sentry` scope after the workspace rename):

| Old | New |
| --- | --- |
| `@sentry-internal/rrweb` 2.41.0 | `@sentry/rrweb` 2.44.0 |
| `@sentry-internal/rrweb-player` 2.41.0 | `@sentry/rrweb-player` 2.44.0 |
| `@sentry-internal/rrweb-snapshot` 2.41.0 | `@sentry/rrweb-snapshot` 2.44.0 |
| `@sentry-internal/rrweb-types` 2.43.0 (dev) | `@sentry/rrweb-types` 2.44.0 |

## Why (Trusted Types)

The published 2.41.0 builds are **Svelte 4** and render control icons via raw `innerHTML` — a Trusted Types sink that fires on any replay view. **2.44.0** is compiled with **Svelte 5**, whose runtime routes its static-template `innerHTML` through a Trusted Types policy (`create_trusted_html`), so the sink is gone at the source with no local patch. Bumping the whole family together keeps the versions aligned (the player bundles core/snapshot, but the app also imports core/snapshot directly).

## Compatibility

- Player's class-component API is preserved via Svelte's `asClassComponent`; `new RRWebPlayer({target, props})` is unchanged.
- 2.41→2.44 core is type-compatible across all 18 touched files (typecheck: 0 errors).
- **265 replay tests** (`components/replays`, `utils/replays`) pass unchanged.
- Lockfile diff is rrweb-family-only — the unrelated pnpm babel-peer churn was reverted, and `--frozen-lockfile` passes.

## QA

No rrweb-player specs exist; replay suites + typecheck pass. Worth a visual check of a replay in the issue view (playback, controls, fullscreen button, styles).
